title: Upcoming elections discovery
description: Web-search prompt that lists the next upcoming election events (one row per event, party primaries split) for the voter's jurisdiction as JSON.

variables.name: civicElections
variables.description: Upcoming elections from Google Civic, context only. At most 6 are included.

variables.name: state
variables.description: Voter's state name; defaults to "the voter's state" in naming rules.

variables.name: todayIso
variables.description: Reference date; only elections strictly after it are returned.

variables.name: todayLabel
variables.description: Reference date in long form (e.g. `Saturday, October 24, 2026`).

variables.name: topElectionCount
variables.description: How many upcoming events to return before adding the next presidential election. Default 3.

usage.notes: Sent to the OpenAI Responses API with web search. Same wording as symthink-io; blank lines around the jurisdiction and Google Civic elections blocks are now consistent (symthink-io omits some of them).
